rubric.role_summary: Experienced, full-cycle accountant for an AI safety nonprofit, responsible for accounting operations and close processes as its first in-house accountant.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Experienced, full-cycle accountant for an AI safety nonprofit, responsible for accounting operations and close processes as its first in-house accountant.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of hands-on accounting experience with demonstrated ownership of full-cycle accounting responsibilities.
- Experience working with spreadsheets and accounting/financial software.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with nonprofit accounting, including fund accounting, grant reporting, and 990 preparation.
- Familiarity with multi-entity or multi-currency accounting.
- Experience supporting or coordinating external audits.
- Experience developing or improving financial controls.
- Experience implementing or improving systems.
- Experience in a startup-like environment.
- Ability to work across spreadsheets and financial systems, including Google Sheets, Quickbooks Online, Ramp, Mercury, and Airtable.
- Track record of working independently with minimal oversight.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; United States (remote). Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
